r.t: Originally I tried to make his doc readable for anyone who has no clue of Rick and Morty, and that's why I only name Rick and everyone else I just refer to as grandson or soldier or smth but I gave up midway so sometimes I refer to characters by their name or their relationship to Rick

BTW Rick and Morty is about a super smart inventor named Rick (also an interdimensional  terrorist who can travel between different realities) who takes his grandson Morty on many adventures. Recommend watching for the fun not the scd since outsmarting really isn’t the highlight.
Ricks Strategy to beat a 4D time police (Season 2 Episode 1)

After freezing time for half a month, the time Rick, Morty and Summer are in becomes very unstable, after Morty and Summer argue Rick finds out that their timeline has split. Rick knows this was caused since both Morty and Summer had many uncertainties and randomness in their action causing them to create parallel timelines. Rick also sees the outside is not their reality and reasons that because the two timelines are now split they are not in their proper timeline but are in the realm of uncertainty. After trying a timeline merger machine, it does not work as Morty and Summer from the different timelines have deviated in position too far to be merged. Rick reasons this is caused by their light being influenced by the quantum wind. Rick being aware and clear on what to do is not easily influenced by chaos theory and uncertain factors to his actions allowing him to operate at similar states even after being exposed to a different situation. Now Rick needs to sync the two into the same position to remerge time, so one of the Ricks swaps Morty and Summers positions. After seeing the two argue over who is least useful, Rick realizes the two are in conflict because they want his approval, so Rick says that both of them are pieces of trash and lectures them about it, with this both Morty and Summer get more in sync as both Ricks act in similar fashion. Now after Rick tries to merge time it fails again as one of the Morty’s have created a slight deviation. Rick, after the merger fails, assumes the worst, which is that his alternate self decided to kill him. By killing off one of the uncertainties the other can become the only possible timeline, returning to the original timeline, Rick considers this the final method but since this is a first strike advantage, Rick prepares a time gun and shoots his alternate self, his alternate self has the same line of thought and the two start a timeline shootout, creating more uncertainty splitting the timeline into 4. After Morty knocks Rick unconscious for going crazy Rick is in a cage. Now he goes in to check that all his other timelines are ready to merge by sending voicemails, after confirming that all of them said the same thing, he knows his position is in sync. Now the 4D time police have come in all the sudden to solve this mess. After giving the 3 a device to sync their movement the timeline merges again, but the 4D time police is unhappy about Rick stealing resources to make his time fiddling device and his trying to threaten Rick. Rick tells the 4D existence to turn around saying “you are a 4th dimensional existence meaning our time is one direction for you meaning you have infinite time, and with infinite time you’ll eventually do everything such as turning around” with this sophistry the alien gets confused  and turn around then Rick hits him in the head with a wrench.  Now the 4D police tries to resist but now Rick takes advantage of the fact that he is a 4th dimensional existence that exist in all of the parallel timelines at once, he makes his mind very uncertain and assaults the police officer, with Ricks random actions the timeline split into many to about 32, and in all 32 timelines Rick is split, they are all attacking one police officer as he exists in all timelines at once, beating him instantly. Now Rick fixes the time syncing device the police gave them before to merge time again.
Ricks Strategy to beat a alien reality simulation (Season 1 Episode 4)

First after seeing Morty being staged to leak the formula to his new antimatter fuel formula he created he realizes that his alien enemies seeking his enemies have captured him in a simulation. Knowing that they hate nudes, Rick and Morty strip to avoid their surveillance. Now Rick decides to hold a concert and advertise the crowd to gather to hear his new formula, Rick says he needs more people to say their new formula, and makes specific people make weird moves, this lags out the simulation so after they run, they reach the edge of the simulation. Rick knew this would happen because the aliens didn’t have enough computational power to simulate everything, that's why the random movement of the crowd lagged the server and the server didn’t simulate everything so he found the edge of the simulation. After escaping Rick knew there was a chance it was still a simulation so after he got home, he opened his invention vault with the wrong password to mislead the aliens. After it opened he knew he was still in a simulation. After he escaped again and flew on a space ship the aliens revealed they know the recipe already which confirms to Rick that they are trying to lower his guard to reveal the formula, Rick acts deceived and tells a fake formula. After the aliens feel good and release him, the aliens test Rick's formula which was just Rick's misdirection and creates an explosion.

Rick harvests a special stone called death stones that allow you to see how you die. It often shows multiple as life is very uncertain. After getting ambushed by police trying to kill him with guns, Rick uses the death stones to protect himself. By putting a death rock on his forehead, he can constantly see when he is going to die, and after Rick hides in cover, he makes up his mind to peek out of cover. If the enemies are reloading his death will be uncertain since Rick does not die that very instant meaning he has a future, if Rick only sees one type of death and that's by getting shot, Rick knows the enemies are not reloading. Using this Rick dodges all the bullets and kills all the police.

After learning that Rick has to go to therapy with his family to get over all the trauma he caused. Rick, not wanting to go, turns himself into a pickle, he planned to drip anti-pickel serum over himself with a contraption he set up. His plan goes wrong as his daughter takes away the anti-pickel serum, now Rick is rolled down the drain by the rain and ends up in the sewage, by biting his tongue his pickle scent lured rats in which he bit them to death and uses its body to move, he lures a rat into attacking him only for the rat to break a obstacle he needed to break and also made it so breaking that obstacle drops a knife on top of the rat. After upgrading hit suit using the dead rat's body, Rick climbs up the sewage only to find that he is inside a government max security building, now Rick is getting hunted down by agents. Rick finds a room and fills it with traps and bombs, then he goes to another room traveling in vents to avoid detection and hacks the laptop of the room he rigged, then he calls the security room from the laptop he hacked predicting that the one in command will go to the security room. Rick makes random conversation as the one in command sends his men to the room where Rick is supposed to be calling, which is actually a trap and most of the men die. The people in the office get real concerned about Pickle Rick and get out a prisoner who was trapped there and was considered one of the most dangerous soldiers which is now hunting Rick. While fighting this man Rick makes sure to attack all the security cameras and makes the man shoot the security cameras by moving near them himself. Now after the soldier says that the man has a daughter and he is trying to kill Rick as his daughter will be freed if he does so, Rick takes advantage of that and convinces him to fight with him against the government. He agrees and Rick tells him to go to the roof as he predicts that the one in command will try to escape from this building once he learns the soldier is dead. Now because there are no cameras Rick can bluff that the soldier is dead the one in command aims to bargain with Rick with money but Rick tells him to give all that money to the soldiers daughter but the one in command says his daughter is dead, and because previously the soldier was extorted by the one in command using his daughter Rick proves to the soldier that the government officials are liars and with his full cooperation Rick moves on to this final move. Rick makes the soldier spill gasoline all over the roof while Rick connects a detonation wire to the roof and places a bunch of bombs in a room no one uses. The one in command controlled by corruption and greed tries to take all the money and confidential files with him as he predicts Rick wants them as he infiltrated the building, which Rick predicted and he used that extra time to set this up. Now going through the vents Rick makes it to the helicopter before the one in command sets the gasoline on the roof on fire, burning the roof detonating the bombs taking the entire building and all of the people in it, and now Rick has no pursuers. Rick uses the helicopter to find his daughter and asks for the anti-pickel serum to return to human.

Rick, now being chased by the space police, takes his family and runs away, but because they had to leave earth his family is extremely unsatisfied. Rick after hearing Jerry complain about being dragged around by Rick makes a plan to 1. Take revenge on Jerry and get control of the family and 2. Make sure the space police never chases him again. Also Rick is currently at war with the citadel of Ricks so he plans to take them down too if he can. Rick first calls the space police to tell his location while acting as Jerry (his daughter's husband), with this Rick gets catched by the space police and Jerry is treated well in the new society run by the space organization where Jerry who is usually a useless person gets a well paying job, it also makes his daughter really angry towards Rick as she thinks he abandoned her. After Rick is in prison he gets hooked to a mind hacking contraption where his brain is getting invaded by another agent who wants to talk to Rick and gather his methods on inventions. Rick's mind starts off in his favorite restaurant where he tells Jerry to fold himself 12 times, which Jerry attempts and does it 6 times before he falls apart, with this Rick now knows this is a simulated reality and also identifies what kind of model the contraption that is hacking his brain is. Now the agent reveals himself and starts making conversation with Rick and Rick constantly mocks him, acting relaxed even though this mind invasion machine will destroy his brain fully once it's done. Rick using his mind influences the brain invasion machine to manifest anything he wants in this mind realm. Now Rick gets into real business as he asks if the police want to see how he invented his portal gun which they say they want to. Now Rick makes it seem like he is entering one of his memories when in reality Rick is just making up the whole scenery to make it look like it. By doing this the police think all the things they are seeing are genuine as people can’t alter their memories by will but Rick can alter the scenery they are watching as it is actually not a memory but a fabricated scenery by Rick. Now Rick distracts the police from this fact by exploring and reflecting on his life during the time the “memory” is supposed to be playing. He tells the police the day he invented his portal gun is the day he lost his wife. Now Rick plays a scene of him losing his family to a bomb sent by a portal and Rick making a portal gun himself by scribbling equations and heading off to get revenge. Rick acts super sad and emotional, coupled with the scenery it makes the police doubt even less that this scene is not genuine, and copies the equations Rick wrote and sends it off to their computers. But the equation Rick wrote was actually not the portal gun formula but a virus that allows Rick full control of the machine and the police couldn't catch up as they thought altering memories were impossible even though they were not in one. Rick, knowing he can’t stay in his brain as it will be melted, transfers his consciousness to the agent interrogating him and enters his mind. The citadel of Ricks, basically Ricks from infinite timelines coming together to fight against the government, hears that Rick has been captured and plans to kill Rick as he might leak information about the citadel. Rick, now entering the mind of the agent, tries to enter the government's maximum security room but the citadel attacks right at that time, sending multiple Ricks to kill the main Rick and all the agents. Rick fights them off and because he hacked and changed the mind hacker into a device to transfer his consciousness before he uses that device to move his consciousness to one of the attacking Ricks and takes control over his body, killing all his allies. Now Rick needs another way to access the government's max security room. Rick takes the consciousness transfer device and takes the ship the citadel sent, now he calls the citadel, tells them he had high casualty and requests the highest ranking officer that is currently accessible, now Rick modifying the consciousness transfer device transfers his consciousness to the high ranking Rick and after becoming a high rank commander orders to destroy the ship he used to be on to eradicate all evidence. Now he goes to the citadel teleportation room where Rick using his high authority teleports the citadel to the government prison’s location and the citadel building and the prison clashes in space. Because all the Ricks in the citadel hate the government and because the government sees all Ricks as terrorists the government and Ricks fight it out. Rick now kidnaps and disguises himself as one of the higher ups of the citadel and infiltrates their room where they have his granddaughter and grandson hostage. Now Rick takes down everyone there but one who has his granddaughter hostage. Morty being free Rick passes Morty a gun saying “it's a fake shoot me in a standoff”. This is because Rick predicted that the person holding his granddaughter hostage will threaten him to drop his weapon where he plans to make a act. Now Rick says his granddaughter is worthless to him because there is infinite of her and threatens him to drop her, while Morty getting annoyed to his carelessness gets angry at Rick, Rick says it was a act to make everyone mock Morty and make him angry, this was all Ricks plan as if Morty gets angry it makes Morty shooting Rick natural and by Morty shooting Rick, the person holding his granddaughter hostage will lower his guard for Rick to shoot with a real gun. Morty gets mad, shoots Rick with a fake gun, Rick pretends to die, lowering the guard of the person who had his granddaughter hostage and then wakes up to shoot him. Now Rick bringing the prison to a warzone can enter max security level rooms without any attention to them. Rick now changes the value the government manages its currency. He makes the currency equal one of itself to zero of itself in value and with this the currency loses all of its value. All the people related to the government kill each other as position no longer means anything and all everyone wants is physical objects. Toppling the entire society the government ran. Now Rick returns to his family where now his daughter feels guilty as she misjudged Rick, Rick predicted that she would not appreciate the life she has with the government and by destroying it Rick made it seem like he did it to protect her, flipping her idea that Rick just abandoned her. Rick also brought both of his grandchildren home after they got taken away by the citadel so Rick's daughter considered Rick even more of a hero. Rick also gave Jerry a really good life for once only to take it away by destroying the government so now Jerry is mad at Rick, with this Jerry gives an ultimatum that it's either Rich or Jerry that gets to stay in the house as the two don’t get along. Rick's daughter feels guilt to her father, divorce Jerry. Now Rick has gotten Jerry out of the house, and taken down the citadel and the government.

Rick invents an acid tub which he tries to convince Morty it's a genius idea. Basically when Rick wants to escape a sticky situation he jumps in a tub that looks toxic in a toxin factory. Rick, when negotiating, intentionally chooses to do it in a toxin factory but he rigs one of the toxin tubs with a fake and places fake bones so they can float up the tub and a breathing tank underneath to stay inside it for a long time until the pursuers leave. Rick also prepared a laser gun at the bottom so if anyone tests the acid by throwing objects he can shoot it and make it look like it eroded. Rick made it so if he ever gets in trouble and gets chased he can make them no longer chase him as he will be dead. Rick once a negotiation fails tries this tactic saying he's better off dead and jumps in with Morty. In this case though, his pursuers stayed around for long unexpectedly and Morty couldn't handle it and got out of the vat ruining Rick's plan, then Morty angers at him for making a crappy plan and in exchange tells Rick to build him something he wants for once. Morty asks for a time checkpoint device where Morty can save a certain time point and come back to it whenever he wants. Rick is infuriated that Morty not only ruins his plan, but mocks his plan and shoves it into his face to command him plans to make Morty appreciate his acid vat plan. Now Rick knows for Morty to appreciate his acid vat, he needs Morty to be in a situation where Morty’s pursuers are not just random people but organizations that are essential for Morty to live a normal life since the acid vat permanently stops all pursuers from ever chasing anyone and that's its main perk, since they will think that person is dead. Rick makes Morty a time checkpoint device but it doesn't work like Morty imagined, and in which when Morty makes a checkpoint, it split the possible outcomes into infinite ones, and if Morty ever goes back to the last checkpoint the device searches for the timeline where Morty was still in the position he checkpointed. But to transfer Morty to the other timeline the Morty on that timeline had to die. After Rick gives the device to Morty, Morty abuses the hell out of it. Rick predicts that Morty will come back to give up the device as living without consequences is boring, and when Morty does come back living life without consequences his mood will already be down by how insignificant he feels, in which Rick can move on to this next tactic. Rick explains everything to Morty and says it's Mortys fault as Morty didn’t listen to his instructions on how the device works, and now Morty feels guilty for doing all the things that he did and killed a lot of Morty’s. Rick says he can merge all the timelines but then Morty has to live with the consequences and with all the guilt in Morty he accepts, and multiple government agencies come to arrest Morty. But Rick made sure to provide one escape option for Morty which was the acid vat, outside his house, now Morty can’t complain to Rick that he set him up as all the consequences was the one he made and Morty needs the vat as he can’t live a normal life without pretending dead. With this Rick makes Morty appreciate the acid vat plan.
